This is not a breach-free claim.

status.description: Optional. Filter bookings by status: upcoming, recurring, past, cancelled, or unconfirmed.

eventTypeId.description: Optional. Filter bookings by event type numeric ID.

start.description: ISO 8601 date-time string for when the booking should start (e.g. 2024-09-15T10:00:00Z).

eventTypeId.description: The numeric ID of the event type to book.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone of the attendee (e.g. America/New_York).

lengthInMinutes.description: Optional. Override the default duration of the booking in minutes.
